summary_en: Acquisition of all shares of ParrotBeak Co., Ltd., a mobile systems and mobile telecommunications company with ¥1.463B FY25E revenue and profitable operations, to be made a wholly-owned subsidiary. Deal value, tender price, premium, minimum/maximum thresholds, and board recommendation not disclosed in excerpt.
title_en: Supplementary Explanation Material Regarding Full Subsidiary Acquisition of ParrotBeak Co., Ltd. (Mobile Systems & Mobile Telecommunications Company) – ¥1.463B Revenue (Black Ink)
translation_en_brief: Ureru Net Advertising Group filed a supplementary explanation document regarding the acquisition of all issued shares of ParrotBeak Co., Ltd., a mobile systems and mobile telecommunications company, for the purpose of making it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The target company recorded ¥1.463 billion in FY25E revenue and operates profitably. The excerpt provided does not include specific deal terms such as acquisition price, tender offer price, premium to market, acceptance thresholds, timeline, or board recommendation. The filing appears to be a supporting document rather than the main MBO announcement, which would typically contain these commercial and procedural terms.
